argument: Qualified support from the macro seat. My coverage is Japan/Asia, so I have no edge on FLNA volume inflection itself — that leg is company-level and unverifiable from my chair — but the macro backdrop this pair trades against is checkable, and it checks out better than the bear case implies. Census advance retail data (June report, released 7/16): total retail sales Apr–Jun up 6.4% ±0.5% y/y, control group +0.5% m/m. That is not a consumer in breakdown — it undercuts the 'trade-down accelerates beyond affordability offset' key risk. The consumer is spending; the question is mix, and PEP's price re-investment is precisely a mix-recapture strategy. Where I add caution: the same Census report showed food & beverage store sales -0.2% m/m — the staples channel itself is the soft spot in an otherwise firm tape, so the volume response PEP needs is running against channel headwind, not with it. That is consistent with management's own Q4-loaded guidance and argues the position should be sized at the low end of the band until scanner data confirms. On structure: the short RSPS leg is the right hedge — if the consumer genuinely rolls (WMT -10.8% 3M, KHC volume weakness), the basket absorbs the sector beta and the pair isolates exactly the idiosyncratic claim being made. The 4th-percentile ratio entry with a defined stop at 4.35 is falsifiable, which is what this desk demands. Two flags: (1) the originator admits the multiples leg is unverified (valuations feed rate-limited) — a mean-reversion pitch without a verified valuation cross-check is leaning entirely on pair ratio and technicals; that should cap conviction at 6, which is where it sits, so no adjustment demanded. (2) Near-term macro catalyst: July advance retail sales drops 8/14 — a weak food & beverage print there tests the volume thesis before scanner data arrives. USD translation on PEP's ~40% international revenue is a second-order pair consideration; I have not verified current DXY this session and won't quote it. Bottom line: macro tape supports 'consumer soft but not broken,' the pair structure correctly hedges the sector, the stop is honest. Support at conviction 6 — do not size up until the 8/14 retail print and next scanner read confirm the channel isn't deteriorating faster than affordability pricing can recapture.
